content:
bbba43f0c * Added CRL verification functionality to certtool. * Added the FSF copyright notices. * Moved all the compatibility interface to the openssl   compatibility library.
ec706eb62 Some fixes pointed out by Dimitri Papadopoulos-Orfanos <papadopo@shfj.cea.fr>
c4b3eae99 gnutls_x509_*_set_dn_by_oid() functions have a raw_flag parameter added. Some other fixes in function types.
fe6db41f8 added some check for the input parameters.
4b0428250 some type fixes. Based on build logs sent by Dimitri Papadopoulos-Orfanos <papadopo@shfj.cea.fr>.
e01342e2c Updated the openpgp key API.
e9964513d Ported to the new libgcrypt (still unstable). Also added the RC2 cipher and improved the PKCS #12 stuff in order to support it.
73916d072 some cleanups.
849311968 Added function to do the MAC verification in the PKCS #12 structure.
4168761ce Added stuff needed to read PKCS #12 bag attributes.
ce784e5c9 Added ability to write Bag attributes LocalKeyId and friendlyName, in order for browsers to be able to import our structures.
2287c92b0 PKCS #12 generation, finaly can interoperate with openssl even in the encrypted case.
61299a220 Some more improvements in the PKCS #12 part. Now it interoperates with openssl pkcs12, in the unencrypted case.
7184b2996 Several more additions to PKCS #12 to allow encrypting bags. Still not interoperable.
cc9b4ae22 More PKCS #12 additions. Now the code can generate PKCS #12 files. Also added the ability to decrypt plain DES encrypted PKCS #8 keys.
3f1f7e4b0 Passwords in PKCS5 and PKCS12 are now restricted to ASCII ones.
703714d0f Some changes in PKCS12 to allow a bag to hold more than one elements.
65ee78490 some pkcs12 improvements.
ec25481a5 Some improvements in PKCS12 parser. Now it can extract private keys from the structure.
2742d2131 some more stuff about PKCS12. Still on early stage and incomplete.
